categories.name: Information Retrieval
categories.definition: General questions seeking facts, definitions, explanations, trivia, or general recommendations not tied to personal accounts or specific local businesses.

categories.name: Personal Data Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about the user's personal information, status of their accounts (non-financial), devices, or personal schedule.

categories.name: Financial Management
categories.definition: Requests or inquiries related to personal finances, bank accounts, credit cards, bills, taxes, and financial transactions, including reporting issues, checking balances, making payments, or requesting services.

categories.name: Local Search & Recommendations
categories.definition: Finding businesses, services, points of interest, or recommendations based on location or specific criteria.

categories.name: Booking & Reservations
categories.definition: Making, checking, confirming, or canceling reservations for events, travel, dining, or resources.

categories.name: Device & Assistant Control
categories.definition: Commands to control the assistant's settings, connected devices, or general system functions.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Sending messages, making calls, or sharing information with others.

categories.name: Media Control
categories.definition: Commands related to playing, pausing, skipping, or identifying media.

categories.name: List Management
categories.definition: Creating, checking, or removing items from personal to-do lists, shopping lists, or reminders.

categories.name: Travel Information
categories.definition: Inquiries about flights, travel rules, traffic, or general travel advice.

categories.name: Utility
categories.definition: Simple tools like calculations, unit conversions, spelling, or random generation.

categories.name: Assistant Self-Referential
categories.definition: Questions about the assistant's identity, capabilities, or origin.

categories.name: General Interaction
categories.definition: Simple greetings, affirmations, negations, or non-command statements.

categories.name: Location Services
categories.definition: Requests related to the user's or a device's current location, or tracking items.

categories.name: Shopping
categories.definition: Inquiries or requests related to purchasing products, finding deals, or product availability.

categories.name: Troubleshooting
categories.definition: Seeking help or instructions for resolving a problem with a device, vehicle, or personal item.

categories.name: Document Management
categories.definition: Requests to retrieve, review, or manage personal documents or files.

categories.name: Web Search
categories.definition: Explicit requests to search the web or specific online sources for information, articles, or images.

categories.name: Ride Hailing
categories.definition: Requests to order a ride from a service.

categories.name: Alarm & Timer Management
categories.definition: Setting, checking, or managing alarms and timers.

categories.name: Weather Information
categories.definition: Inquiries about current weather conditions or forecasts.

categories.name: Calendar Management
categories.definition: Adding, deleting, or modifying events on a personal calendar.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Inquiries or requests related to managing personal account settings or service plans (non-financial).
